Helm calls selector.Matches() for filtering releases by label selector. ArgoCD calls selector.Matches() for application event filtering and defines a custom Selector interface mirroring labels.Selector.Matches. External-DNS calls selector.Matches() for filtering source resources by annotation and label selectors. Ingress-nginx calls namespaceSelector.Matches() for namespace filtering.

| Repo | File | Why |
|------|------|-----|
| helm | `pkg/action/list.go` | Calls selector.Matches(labels.Set(rls.Labels)) for filtering releases by label selector |
| argo-cd | `server/application/application.go` | Calls selector.Matches(labels.Set(a.Labels)) for application event filtering |
| argo-cd | `applicationset/utils/selector.go` | Defines custom Selector interface with Matches(labels.Labels) bool mirroring k8s labels.Selector.Matches |
| argo-cd | `applicationset/generators/generator_spec_processor.go` | Calls selector.Matches(labels.Set(flatParam)) for generator parameter filtering |
| external-dns | `source/source.go` | Calls selector.Matches(labels.Set(srcAnnotations)) for filtering source resources |
| external-dns | `source/gateway.go` | Calls selector.Matches(labels.Set(annots)) and selector.Matches(labels.Set(ns.Labels)) for gateway filtering |
| external-dns | `source/annotations/filter.go` | Calls selector.Matches(labels.Set(item.GetAnnotations())) for annotation-based filtering |
| external-dns | `source/informers/indexers.go` | Calls annotationFilter.Matches(labels.Set(...)) and labelSelector.Matches(labels.Set(...)) for informer indexing |
| ingress-nginx | `internal/ingress/controller/store/store.go` | Calls namespaceSelector.Matches(labels.Set(ns.Labels)) for namespace filtering |
